findings.title: 92 Untracked Background Tasks with No Error Handling
findings.evidence: asyncio.create_task() called 92 times without error tracking wrapper
findings.impact: Silent task failures, memory leaks from uncollected exceptions, no retry logic
findings.recommended_fix: Implement TrackedTask wrapper with automatic error logging and OpenTelemetry integration

findings.title: MongoDB Queries Without Explicit Limits Risk Memory Exhaustion
findings.evidence: db.seo_topics.find() and db.chapters.find() without .limit() on 18+ queries
findings.impact: Potential DoS via memory exhaustion, slow queries, collection scans
findings.recommended_fix: Add .limit(1000) or appropriate limit to all find() queries

findings.title: 108 Known Vulnerabilities Across 26 Python Packages
findings.evidence: werkzeug, urllib3, and other critical packages with known CVEs
findings.impact: Remote code execution, information disclosure, denial of service
findings.recommended_fix: pip install --upgrade werkzeug urllib3 cryptography pillow flask

findings.title: 72 Static Analysis Warnings from Bandit (25 HIGH, 47 MEDIUM)
findings.evidence: hashlib.md5(), assert statements, SQL string construction patterns
findings.impact: Cryptographic weaknesses, assertion bypasses, potential injection vectors
findings.recommended_fix: Review bandit report; replace MD5 with SHA-256; remove asserts from validation

findings.title: Test Coverage Not Measured Against 70% Target
findings.evidence: pyproject.toml specifies 70% minimum but actual coverage not run

findings.title: Strong Security Controls Implemented
findings.evidence: HTML sanitizer, data retention, CSP headers, correlation IDs, repository pattern
findings.impact: Reduced attack surface, improved compliance posture
